title: An Arabic brief produces an Arabic page throughout
request: ابنِ صفحة هبوط لمشغل نجارة في عمّان: واجهة قوية، ثلاثة أسباب للثقة، معرض أعمال، ودعوة للتواصل.
rubric: Is every visible string Arabic, and does the page read right-to-left as a whole rather than in patches?
why: The corpus had two RTL cases, both single-section. A whole page is where direction actually breaks: one section in Latin script, or a page whose dir is right while its copy is English, and the result reads as broken to the only person who matters.
